title: Waypoints explicit subscription confirmation
meta: Source: app/api/waypoints/subscribe/route.ts; immediate durable intent; deliberate confirm within 24 hours; no automatic subscription.
subject: Confirm your DYDD Waypoints subscription
body:
You requested the weekly DYDD Waypoint.

Confirm your email to receive a devotional on Friday mornings at 8:00 AM Eastern:
{{waypoints_confirmation_url}}

This confirmation link expires in 24 hours. If you did not request this, no action is needed and weekly email will not begin. Joining a Circle or creating an account does not subscribe you. Your other email choices remain unchanged.
